title: Implement the online AMP learner and the paper's Table III networks on CPU
summary: PPO now has an optional adversarial motion prior: every control pairs the 61-value AMP state before and after the action, the discriminator scores the pair, and the Eq. (2) style reward joins the task reward. Each update trains the discriminator against the admitted demonstration bank before the unchanged PPO step and then fits a supervised velocity estimator. A second option replaces the [256, 256, 128] MLPs with the paper's estimator, memory encoder, low-level actor, privileged encoder and critic. Tests check exact parity with stock PPO when the prior is off, that privileged inputs never reach the actor, and that checkpoints bind the bank. No native AMP run exists; the flat-ground pilot still needs reward version 2, matching standing admission and the program lead's approval.
next: Agree the pilot budget and decision rule with the program lead, then prepare a training pack with --reward-version 2 --learner amp and matching standing admission for the first flat-ground AMP pilot under issue #37.
reason: CPU implementation and tests only; no native run, checkpoint, measured result, roadmap marker or acceptance gate changes.
